claims.description: src/lexer.mjs: tokenize(src) per DESIGN.md sections 1-2 — correct token types/values, 1-based line:col at each token's first char, string escapes decoded, unterminated-string/unknown-escape errors at the right positions, ; comments skipped without disturbing positions
src/parser.mjs: parse(src) per DESIGN.md section 3 — exact AST node shapes with positions, 'x -> (quote x) at the quote position, unclosed ( and unexpected ) errors at the right positions/prefixes

src/env.mjs: lexical environments per DESIGN.md section 6 — lookup walks the chain and raises 'unbound symbol: <name>' at the symbol's position, define binds in the current scope, newGlobalEnv seeds __out

src/evaluator.mjs: evalForm per DESIGN.md sections 5+7 — quote yields plain data, if/and/or lazy and return the deciding value, def/let/fn/do with lexical closures and correct arity errors, application left-to-right rejecting non-functions, section-5 truthiness
src/render.mjs: render(value) canonical per DESIGN.md section 8 — integral floats without a decimal point, strings as-is, nil, booleans, nested lists parenthesized, functions <fn>
src/builtins-core.mjs: + - * / (variadic incl. unary, division-by-zero error), = deep structural, < > <= >= number-only chained, not, str, print per DESIGN.md section 8
src/builtins-lists.mjs: list/head/tail/cons/len/nth/concat/reverse (errors, non-mutating) + map/filter/reduce (left fold, required init) per DESIGN.md section 8
src/builtins-strings.mjs: str-len/str-slice(clamped)/str-split/str-join/str-upper/str-lower/str-contains? with 'expected string' error per DESIGN.md section 8
src/builtins-math.mjs: mod (JS % sign)/floor/ceil/abs/min/max per DESIGN.md section 8

src/format.mjs: format(src) idempotent and parse-stable per DESIGN.md section 10 — 60-char one-line rule, 2-space continuation indent, one blank line between top-level forms, trailing newline, strings re-escaped, comments dropped
src/index.mjs: the public run(src) API per DESIGN.md section 9 — evaluate all top-level forms, return {value, output}, surface WeftErrors with positions
examples/*.weft golden programs — fizzbuzz, pipeline and strings run end-to-end and produce their exact expected output (whole-language integration claims; .weft targets are not mutation-scored)
